entities.name: Timer T3586
entities.description: Timer used in the remote UE report procedure. On expiry, the UE resends REMOTE UE REPORT message and restarts timer. After third expiry, procedure is aborted.

entities.name: Remote UE report procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE sends REMOTE UE REPORT message to report remote UE information. Can be aborted on timer T3586 expiry or collision with PDU session release.

entities.name: REMOTE UE REPORT message
entities.description: Message sent by UE during remote UE report procedure to report remote UE information.

entities.name: Network-requested PDU session release procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by network to release a PDU session, triggered by PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message.

entities.name: PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message
entities.description: Message sent by network to initiate PDU session release procedure.

entities.name: First expiry of timer T3586
entities.description: Condition when timer T3586 expires for the first time. UE resends REMOTE UE REPORT and restarts timer.

entities.name: Third expiry of timer T3586
entities.description: Condition when timer T3586 expires for the third time. UE aborts remote UE report procedure and releases resources.

entities.name: Collision with PDU session release
entities.description: Condition when UE receives PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND for same PDU session ID as in REMOTE UE REPORT during remote UE report procedure.

entities.name: Abort procedure
entities.description: Behavior where UE stops the ongoing procedure and releases associated resources.

entities.name: Resend message
entities.description: Behavior where UE retransmits a message, specifically REMOTE UE REPORT message on T3586 expiry.

relations.description: Remote UE report procedure starts timer T3586.
First expiry of T3586 establishes resending of REMOTE UE REPORT message.
First expiry of T3586 causes timer to be reset and restarted.
Third expiry of T3586 establishes abortion of remote UE report procedure.
Collision with PDU session release establishes abortion of remote UE report procedure.
Collision condition establishes proceeding with network-requested PDU session release procedure.
Remote UE report procedure includes sending REMOTE UE REPORT message.
Network-requested PDU session release procedure includes receiving PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message.
